title: TriadFi
tagline: AI-assisted DeFi trading infrastructure for institutional investors and asset managers
description:
We have built an AI-driven trading platform designed for institutional adoption, where investors can allocate capital and trade with the assistance of autonomous AI agents.

https://github.com/Triad-Finance/triad-fi

At the heart of the platform are three specialized agents that work together to identify opportunities, manage risk, and execute trades seamlessly on decentralized exchanges such as 1inch:

🔹 Agents

Signal Agent – Continuously analyzes market data, applying AI-driven technical indicators and strategies (e.g., RSI, MACD, trend models) to generate actionable trade signals.

Risk Agent – Validates each proposed trade against predefined risk frameworks (exposure caps, volatility filters, portfolio allocation rules) to ensure compliance and safety.

Execution Agent – Determines the optimal time and limit price for each order. It then places and manages the trade directly on 1inch DEX, ensuring best execution with minimal slippage.

🔹 Asset Managers (AMC)

Beyond investors, the platform enables AI-assisted Asset Managers (AMCs) to design, deploy, and manage trading strategies. These managers can:

Encode strategies into the agent framework.

Leverage AI reasoning (e.g., symbolic + neural methods) to adapt to market conditions.

Offer whitelabeled strategies to institutions, enabling tailored products for hedge funds, family offices, and DAOs.

🔹 Key Features

AI-Driven Trading → Smart market analysis with autonomous decision-making.

Risk-First Design → Built-in constraints and compliance checks for institutional trust.

Limit Order Execution → Dynamic placement on 1inch with adaptive pricing.

Whitelabel Ready → Customizable for financial institutions and asset managers.

Dual Ecosystem → Investors provide capital; AMCs provide strategies, creating a marketplace of AI-driven funds.
how_its_made:
Our platform combines AI reasoning, autonomous agents, and DeFi protocols to create an institutional-grade trading framework.

🔹 Core Architecture

Fetch.ai uAgents → The backbone of our system, enabling lightweight, autonomous, and message-driven AI agents.

Three-Agent Workflow:

Signal Agent – Built with Python and integrated technical indicators (RSI, MACD, ML models) to generate trade signals based on Swap Token data from TheGraph Token API

Risk Agent – Encodes institutional risk constraints (exposure, volatility, liquidity) using both rule-based logic and symbolic reasoning (via MeTTa – Meta Type Talk). Data based on TheGraph Token API and CoinDesk

Execution Agent – Uses the 1inch Limit Order Protocol to place buy/sell orders at optimal prices, managing order lifecycle and slippage protection.

🔹 Strategy Layer (AMCs)

Asset Managers (AMCs) can design strategies directly in MeTTa or Python, which plug into the Signal + Risk pipeline.

Strategies are modular and whitelabel-ready for institutions to adopt or customize.

🔹 AI Reasoning & Risk Management

MeTTa (Hyperon’s reasoning language) is embedded inside agents to represent constraints and adapt strategies dynamically.

Combines neural (ML) + symbolic (MeTTa) AI for explainable decision-making with reliable data from TheGraph's Token API

🔹 DeFi & On-Chain Execution

1inch DEX Integration → Secure limit order placement via smart contracts.

Wallet Integration → Each agent signs and submits transactions using EVM-compatible wallets.

Transparency → Attested trade logs on-chain for investor and institutional auditability.

🔹 Whitelabel Product

Modular architecture makes it easy to rebrand, configure, and deploy for hedge funds, DAOs, and family offices.

Institutions can plug in their own strategies while relying on our agent framework + execution layer.

✅ Tech Stack Highlights

Agents: Fetch.ai uAgents (Python SDK)

Reasoning: MeTTa (OpenCog Hyperon) for symbolic AI

Trading: 1inch Limit Order Protocol, EVM wallets

Data: On-chain (TheGraph) + off-chain (Coindesk) price feeds, technical indicators and historical social data

Deployment: Whitelabel SaaS/DeFi hybrid for institutions
